title: 补齐 Electron 启动、交互与长期运行性能计数器

originalAcceptance.criterion: 记录 app-ready、window-created、ready-to-show、renderer-first-paint 四个启动 marks 及相对耗时
渲染进程记录 >=50ms long task、点击/键盘输入延迟和 IPC P50/P95，并写入本地 JSON ring buffer
evidence: src/lib/performance-metrics.ts persists schema clawx.renderer-performance/v1 to localStorage under clawx.performance.metrics.v1

originalAcceptance.criterion: 主进程真实计数 spawn 次数、活跃 setInterval、活跃 watcher；缺失时明确标注 unavailable
evidence: electron/utils/counted-child-process.ts is used by all main child_process value imports changed in this node

originalAcceptance.criterion: 同一命令可重复生成 5 分钟 idle 基线，不上传网络，产物含 driven_by=agent
evidence: probe.mjs launches local Electron with --disable-gpu and writes local JSON only; no network upload path exists.

gates.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/performance-metrics.test.ts tests/unit/efficiency-sampling-panel.test.tsx tests/unit/runtime-efficiency-api.test.ts tests/unit/git-api.test.ts

boundaries: The five-minute run is idle and agent-driven; it is not a real-user interaction trace.
activeWatchers=0 is a measured value for this Main process run, not an unavailable field; the counter currently covers the fs.watch wrapper surface used by Main.
Renderer IPC samples are capped by the local 256-entry ring buffer, so count=256 is a bounded sample count, not a claim about total lifetime calls.
Long-task support is browser/Electron dependent; this run reported four measured long tasks and no unavailable marker.
No upload, external APM, performance claim, or real-human evidence is involved.
